checks.basis: Candidate and execution contracts preserve an unbounded player-visible tower, 100F as milestone rather than ending, 101F+, deterministic district/cycle/modifier/background generation and arbitrary-precision floor handling.
A single reset.tower_return returns to Floor 1, repeat-best ruby is zero, evolution is every 100 levels, catch-up is ordered and evolution does not block level continuation.
Character and weapon pools are separated, 100/200 guarantees are modeled, first copy is functional, full mastery requires 20 additional effective copies and overflow is not discarded.
Step 2 seals executable semantics and bounded qualification only. The 15000-scenario balance matrix and full high-volume statistical qualification remain explicitly owned by Step 3.

findings.finding: Actual balance outcomes for first-reset timing distributions, 30-45 day F2P guarantee reach, build parity and payer acceleration have not been accepted from full sample volumes.
findings.requiredNextStage: Execute and judge the sealed 15000-scenario gameplay matrix and high-volume suites in Step 3 before claiming balance quality.
